newsitem.title: USA: Integon Q3 hurt by hurricane losses.
newsitem.headline: Integon Q3 hurt by hurricane losses.

text.p: Integon Corp said on Thursday its third quarter results were hurt by losses stemming from Hurricanes Fran and Bertha.

The company said in a statement the latest industry estimate of insured property damage from Hurricane Fran was $1.6 billion. Most of this damage occurred in North Carolina, Integon's largest state based on direct written premium volume.

President and chief executive James T. Lambie said, "Our losses to date from Fran, net of reinsurance, are approximately $2.4 million. A portion of the losses we have sustained are in a homeowners' book of business which is being discontinued this year with the remaining claims relating to damaged automobiles."
Hurricane Bertha, which occurred in July, was much less destructive and resulted in about $600,000 in losses for the company, the statement said.
Final results for Integon's third quarter will be reported on Oct 24. The quarter ends Sept 30.
